title: The IoT Revolution: ESP8266 and ESP32
summary: Explore the wireless powerhouses: the ESP8266 WiFi module and the dual-core ESP32 with built-in Bluetooth and high-speed processing.

steps.title: Cutting the Cable: The Wireless Revolution
steps.markdownContent: Some ESP boards have Wi-Fi built in. ESP32 boards may also support Bluetooth. Features and pins vary by board, so check its pin map before wiring.

quickCheck.question: What wireless feature is built into many ESP boards?
quickCheck.explanation: Many ESP boards include Wi-Fi. Features vary by board.
quickCheck.warmupExplanation: A standard Arduino Uno needs external add-on shields for wireless, while ESP chips have radios built right inside the chip.

quickCheck.question: How does the clock speed of an ESP32 (up to 240 MHz) compare to an Arduino Uno (16 MHz)?
options: The ESP32 is much faster (over 10 times the processor speed)
They are the exact same speed
quickCheck.explanation: At 240 MHz with dual 32-bit cores, the ESP32 crunches numbers up to 15 times faster than an 8-bit Arduino Uno running at 16 MHz!
quickCheck.warmupExplanation: The Uno is like a trusty bicycle; the ESP32 is like an electric sports car.

steps.title: ESP8266 vs. ESP32: Inside the Silicon
steps.markdownContent: An ESP board can connect a project to a network. You do not need to memorize chip speeds or pin counts yet.

steps.title: IoT Code Architecture: Connecting to Wi-Fi
steps.markdownContent: Watch the Wi-Fi connection simulator. In a real project, the board needs the right library, network name, and password. Keep real passwords private.

steps.title: Check Your Knowledge
steps.markdownContent: Test your understanding of the wireless microcontroller revolution with ESP8266 and ESP32!

interactiveConfig.question: Which microcontroller chip has BOTH Wi-Fi and Bluetooth radios built directly inside it?
interactiveConfig.explanation: The ESP32 features integrated 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and dual-mode Bluetooth (Classic + BLE) on a single silicon chip.

questions.question: Which microcontroller chip has BOTH Wi-Fi and Bluetooth radios built directly inside it?
questions.explanation: The ESP32 features integrated 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and dual-mode Bluetooth (Classic + BLE) on a single silicon chip.

learningGoal: Recognize that ESP boards can add wireless features to a project.

vocabulary.meaning: A way for devices to connect to a network without wires.
